summary: Milestone 4 PDP end-to-end validation. Backend: 34/34 pytest passed (test_catalog.py + test_m3_filters.py) — PDP endpoint returns category.department, media[2], variants, translations. Frontend PDP: all specified behaviors verified — default in-stock variant, cross-dimension auto-resolve on hijab (Maroon→Chiffon OOS), price override (Gray+XXL Rp 519,000; Halal Gentle Facial Wash 50ml Rp 49,000 vs 100ml Rp 79,000), BLK+XXL OOS + cart disabled, NVY+L in stock, quantity cap at 2 for GRY-XS low stock (plus disabled at 2), Size Guide dialog opens on hoodie only, no size selector/no size guide on hijab and skincare, SALE badge + strikethrough Rp 189,000 on brightening-serum, Halal Certified badge on skincare, thumbnails (2) render, breadcrumb Home/UNIQLO Products/Sweatshirts & Hoodies/Product, 404 shows empty-state 'Page not found' without crash, i18n RU switches title/labels/CTA and persists on reload, mobile 390px no horizontal overflow. Regression: homepage sections + card link → PDP, PLP filters render, /search?q=abaya returns 1 product. Zero console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Skincare 'How to Use' section uses data-testid `pdp-section-directions` (not `pdp-section-howToUse`) — consistent with i18n key `pdp.sections.directions`; label renders correctly. Non-blocking naming note only.

PDP main image is rendered as background-image on the container (not an ), so any future automated test asserting an under [data-testid=pdp-main-image] will fail. Consider adding an or data-image-url attribute for testability if needed. Non-blocking.
